newsitem.title: USA: Safeskin to move production, take charge.
newsitem.headline: Safeskin to move production, take charge.

text.p: Safeskin Corp said it plans to move all remaining production of its lightly powdered and powder-free examination gloves from Malaysia to a new facility in Thailand during 1997.
Safeskin said it would take a $3 million charge in its year-end 1996 financial statements related to the move.
It said the transfer was expected to result in improved profit margins in 1997 and future years due to the lower production costs in Thailand.
The company said it anticipated that the incremental earnings resulting from this transfer will fully offset the amount of the restructuring charge within 18 months.
The move is expected to increase gross margins in future years, beginning in 1997.

Safeskin Malaysia will continue to operate the main facility -- known as factory one -- for "higher value products," such as the newly introduced Safeskin 2000 powder free surgeon's glove, the Scientific Division's Hypoclean products and synthetic nitrile products.
Factory two in Malaysia is expected to be closed by the end of 1997, but its shutdown is not anticipated to require the layoff of any Safeskin Malaysia employees.
